_doc: Every content file the game loads. Add a new interior by dropping a JSON file in content/maps/ and listing it here, then link it from a campus building ('interior') — see README. After editing content, run `node tools/build-content.js` so the offline/file:// bundle matches. Class arms (JSS1A…SS3C) and the Junior/Senior Block hallways are generated from content/school.json + the classroom templates when content loads (js/core/content.js).
